prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset for a hand painted 2D side-scrolling minecart platform game. Reference is art direction ONLY. Generate a landscape 16:9 BACKGROUND layer, no hero, no cart, no apples, no HUD, NO foreground playable rails or platforms. A lush ancient mine cavern opening into a misty turquoise gorge: enormous organically curved rock arches interwoven with tree roots, distant hanging bridges, small warm amber windows, thin waterfalls falling into fog. Layered low contrast desaturated teal shapes in the distance, muted warm brown stone in middle distance. Leave central horizontal gameplay band y=35%-85% open with soft atmospheric depth; do not place large high contrast objects there. Highest detail around top cavern edge and distant architecture, nothing resembling rectangular tiled blocks. Painterly brushwork and charming animated-film game art matching reference, no heavy outlines. World must be orthographic side view, no floor perspective. Left and right edges should have matching subdued teal cavern atmosphere so it can scroll seamlessly. No typography.
prompts.rock: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game terrain material texture, full frame entirely filled with warm slate brown and muted violet natural rock face. Hand painted painterly stylized animation background quality matching supplied reference rocks. Large irregular interlocking cracked stone masses, chipped angular facets, warm ochre highlights from upper left, deep plum crevices, subtle weathered brush texture, restrained detail. Occasional tiny moss ochre-green in cracks. NOT brickwork, NOT rows, NOT cobblestones, NOT a photo. Front-on vertical rock cliff texture, no perspective. Even lighting and detail across frame, tileable edges, no central focal point. No scene, sky, rails, floor, text, objects, borders. This will be mapped to organically shaped hanging stone terrain polygons under minecart rails.
prompts.terrain: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: FINAL PRODUCTION 2D GAME TERRAIN SPRITE, not a concept screenshot. Match the exceptional painted craftsmanship and materials of the supplied minecart game reference. Generate one wide landscape image with TRUE TRANSPARENT background. A horizontally seamless side-view terrain strip: beautifully hand-painted warm brown/plum cliff rock, twisted roots, lush tiny moss patches, thin warm metal minecart rail along its perfectly HORIZONTAL top, with thick individual aged wooden sleepers directly underneath. The rail must run CONTINUOUSLY from the absolute LEFT edge to the absolute RIGHT edge of image with no gaps. Rail contact line at about 18% image height; transparent empty margin above. Solid rock immediately under track, hanging down irregularly to 80-95% image height in large beautifully sculpted natural overhangs and pointed rock contours. Roots wrap rock and trail below, small ferns and moss below track only. Rock has rich painterly lighting, carved facets, hairline cracks and beautiful textured brushwork, NOT outlined polygon art or cartoon sticker rocks. The terrain is ONE joined continuous ledge cropped at left and right so edges can repeat, not isolated stones, not a sprite sheet. No tall objects extending above rail. No pillars extending to ground. 100% orthographic side elevation, rail is one thin horizontal line (no perspective, no visible top surface ellipse). Warm amber highlights and muted dark violet shadows. No scenery, sky, haze, background, characters, apple collectibles, UI, title, text, drop shadow or labels. Real alpha outside uneven silhouette. This is the foreground players will actually drive on. It must look as carefully painted as the supplied reference ground, NOT like a vector approximation.
prompts.bridge: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D game asset, TRUE TRANSPARENT background, wide landscape 3:1. Match supplied painted platform art. ONE continuous horizontal suspended wooden minecart bridge strip, cropped at LEFT and RIGHT edges so it can repeat. Thin metal rail running perfectly horizontally from left edge to right edge at 35% image height. Richly painted thick aged wooden plank sleepers and load-bearing wooden beam immediately under rail; individual carved grain, metal bolts, chipped edges, golden amber highlights and brown shadows. Below the bridge a thick braided rope swags gently, with knots and short vertical rope hangers. The bridge strip occupies middle 60% of image height, transparent above and below. This is a side-on orthographic game sprite, no perspective or visible top of deck. NO stone, background, scenery, pillars, people, carts, text, symbols or HUD. Intricate painterly craftsmanship comparable to a high quality hand painted console platformer. Avoid vector shapes, heavy outlines, simplistic planks.
prompts.zip: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: TWO production 2D side-view minecart zipline props on TRUE TRANSPARENT background, one image with generous clear spacing. LEFT HALF: a tall twisted wooden tree-root support, narrow base below and bent cantilever at top with a large brass grooved pulley mounted near its right end, rope binding, aged wood grain, little moss and two leaves. It is a freestanding 2D side-on anchor for a rope; no cable extending away, no ground, no scene. Pulley center about 65% down from top and 75% across left half. RIGHT HALF: a compact zipline trolley with TWO side-by-side small brass roller wheels on top, heavy wooden crossbar directly below, a brass hanging ring below crossbar, detailed bolted wood and gleaming metal. Nothing hanging beneath the ring. Props do NOT touch each other. Rich, beautiful hand-painted amber wood and golden brass with muted plum shadows, subtle painterly strokes, same production quality as supplied game reference, no vector look, no thick cartoon outlines. No labels, text, scenery, carts, people, HUD or drop shadows. Everything fully contained within each half, transparent margins.
prompts.foliage: Use case: stylized-concept. Final production 2D platform game FOREGROUND PARALLAX overlay, landscape 3:1, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. A sparse fringe of beautifully hand-painted dark plum and deep teal fern fronds, broad curling leaves, delicate grass, a few little ochre mushrooms and mossy root ends growing from BELOW the bottom edge. Plants cluster only in the bottom-left 25% and bottom-right 20% of the image, central 55% completely transparent and empty. The tallest plant reaches only 30% up from the BOTTOM edge. Upper 65% entirely transparent. Leaves have rich textured brushwork and delicate golden rim light, intentionally mostly dark silhouettes for foreground depth. No soil strip, no rocks, no backdrop, no sky, no characters, no UI, no frame, no typography, no shadows on background. Side-view painted console platformer artwork matching reference, not vector art.
prompts.heart: Use case: stylized-concept. One small polished red heart HUD icon for a premium hand painted 2D platformer game on TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Single symmetrical plump ruby-red heart, warm scarlet upper lobes, rich burgundy bottom shadow, delicate peach reflected light, small creamy highlight on upper left lobe. Beautiful subtle painted brushwork, soft volumetric shading, clean silhouette with a very fine dark warm-brown edge only, no thick blue outline, no white stroke. Icon fills central 70% of square canvas. No background, frame, lettering, other objects, shadow outside the icon or sparkle particles. Production game UI asset designed to remain crisp at 40 pixels.
